# MMO框架知识图谱

## 总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Client["客户端 (C#)"]
    LoginSrv["登录服务器"]
    GatewaySrv["网关服务器"]
    AppSrv["App服务器"]
    MapSrv["地图服务器"]
    DataSrv["数据服务器"]
    Redis["Redis (内存缓存)"]
    PostgreSQL["PostgreSQL (持久化)"]
    Docker["Docker (容器)"]
    WSL["WSL (Linux 环境)"]
    HotUpdate["热更新模块 (JD 脚本)"]
    AOI["AOI 模块"]
    Trade["交易模块"]
    Team["组队模块"]
    Battle["战斗系统"]
    Task["任务系统"]
    MailGM["邮件 / GM 工具"]

    Client --> LoginSrv
    LoginSrv --> GatewaySrv
    GatewaySrv --> AppSrv
    AppSrv --> MapSrv
    MapSrv --> DataSrv
    DataSrv --> Redis
    DataSrv --> PostgreSQL
    Server["服务器集群"] --> Docker
    Server --> WSL
    Client --> HotUpdate
    Server --> AOI
    Server --> Trade
    Server --> Team
    Server --> Battle
    Server --> Task
    Server --> MailGM
```

## AOI（视野）工作原理
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Player["玩家角色"]
    NPC["NPC 实体"]
    Move["玩家移动"]
    AOICheck["服务器 AOI 检查"]
    DistThresh["距离阈值"]
    Hide["隐藏 NPC"]
    Show["显示 NPC"]
    VisRange["可视范围"]

    Move --> AOICheck
    AOICheck -->|距离 > 阈值| Hide
    AOICheck -->|距离 ≤ 阈值| Show
    Player --> VisRange
    NPC --> VisRange
    VisRange --> DistThresh
    DistThresh --> AOICheck
```

## 交易流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    PlayerA["玩家 A"]
    PlayerB["玩家 B"]
    InitTrade["发起交易"]
    TradeWin["交易窗口"]
    AddItem["添加物品/金币"]
    ConfirmA["玩家 A 确认"]
    ConfirmB["玩家 B 确认"]
    SyncBackpack["同步背包"]
    Complete["完成交易"]
    UpdateGold["更新金币"]
    UpdateItems["更新物品"]

    PlayerA --> InitTrade
    InitTrade --> TradeWin
    PlayerB --> TradeWin
    TradeWin --> AddItem
    AddItem --> ConfirmA
    AddItem --> ConfirmB
    ConfirmA --> SyncBackpack
    ConfirmB --> SyncBackpack
    SyncBackpack --> Complete
    Complete --> UpdateGold
    Complete --> UpdateItems
```

## 组队与战斗流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Leader["队长 (玩家 1)"]
    Member["队员 (玩家 2)"]
    Invite["组队邀请"]
    InviteWin["组队窗口"]
    Accept["接受邀请"]
    SyncMove["位置同步 (跟随)"]
    EnterBattle["进入战斗"]
    Attack["攻击"]
    Defense["防御"]
    BattleEnd["战斗结束"]
    Reward["奖励模块"]
    UpdateTask["任务进度更新"]
    Disband["解散队伍"]

    Leader --> Invite
    Invite --> InviteWin
    Member --> InviteWin
    InviteWin --> Accept
    Accept --> SyncMove
    SyncMove --> EnterBattle
    EnterBattle --> Attack
    EnterBattle --> Defense
    Attack --> BattleEnd
    Defense --> BattleEnd
    BattleEnd --> Reward
    Reward --> UpdateTask
    UpdateTask --> Disband
```

## 客户端热更新与开发环境
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CSharpCore["C# 核心 API"]
    JDscript["JD 脚本 (热更新)"]
    BTscript["BT 脚本 (UI)"]
    ResBundle["资源包"]
    HotMgr["热更新管理器"]
    Docker["Docker 容器"]
    WSL["WSL (Linux 子系统)"]
    ServerBuild["服务器构建"]
    ClientBuild["客户端构建"]
    UIBugFix["UI Bug 修复"]
    DeployLinux["部署到 Linux 环境"]

    CSharpCore --> JDscript
    JDscript --> HotMgr
    HotMgr --> ResBundle
    CSharpCore --> BTscript
    BTscript --> UIBugFix
    Docker --> ServerBuild
    WSL --> DeployLinux
    ServerBuild --> DeployLinux
    ClientBuild --> CSharpCore
    ClientBuild --> JDscript
```
